subject.title: feat: add private AWS workspace service

question: Should Crabbox core own this dedicated private AWS workspace API and ECS deployment as a supported coordinator mode?
rationale: The patch adds a specialized route contract, configuration surface, deployment stack, and ongoing operations commitment; code correctness and automated tests cannot determine whether that product boundary belongs in core.

options.title: Accept after proof
options.body: Keep the mode in core after removing the changelog entry and proving the authenticated target-account lifecycle and security posture.

options.title: Externalize the service
options.body: Retain reusable AWS provider capabilities in core while moving the dedicated API and deployment contract outside this repository.

options.title: Pause the feature
options.body: Defer or close the PR if maintainers do not want Crabbox to support this specialized service surface.

recommendation.title: Accept after proof
recommendation.body: Keep the mode in core after removing the changelog entry and proving the authenticated target-account lifecycle and security posture.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the dominant current-main contributor across the affected coordinator, AWS, Node runtime, and authentication architecture.
